title: Minimum Difference Between Highest and Lowest of K Scores
summary: Given an array of student scores and an integer k, select any k scores such that the gap between the highest and lowest selected scores is as small as possible.
statement: Given an array of student scores and an integer k, select any k scores such that the gap between the highest and lowest selected scores is as small as possible. Return this smallest gap.
constraints: nums has 1 through 1000 scores from 0 through 100000; 1 <= k <= len(nums).
Return the smallest possible difference between the largest and smallest selected scores.
hints: For fixed minimum and maximum, choosing interior scores cannot improve the span.
Sort scores; an optimal selection appears inside some consecutive window of k sorted values.
Any k selected scores span at least the k-value sorted window beginning at their smallest rank, so checking every such window includes an optimum.
editorial: Any k selected scores span at least the k-value sorted window beginning at their smallest rank, so checking every such window includes an optimum.

tests.explanation: Selecting seven and nine gives difference two, which is minimum.
Selecting the only score gives a difference of zero.
